{{Top|leg}}
An '''egg clutch''' was the form of reproduction of the [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]] reptilian, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Vodrans laid egg clutches and each individual clutch gave birth to either two or three young Vodrans. The [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurians]] were also born in clutches, as [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] spoke of his "clutch-siblings."
